items.title: I have 27 credit cards and CardPointers saves me hundreds of dollars: Here's what to know
items.why: Enthusiast tracking tools show cardholders actively managing perks, so benefit usability matters as much as the perk itself.
items.summary_ai: A TPG writer praises CardPointers for tracking card offers and perks, and points readers to a discounted premium membership.
